title: Mixing: Cleanup Time by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

The penultimate mixing session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 17 October 1980.

This session was to remix Lennon’s song ‘Cleanup Time’. The song had been recorded on 13 August and 5 and 17 September 1980.

The remix of ‘Cleanup Time’ was completed on 19 October, the final studio session for Double Fantasy.
